name: What is the process for an interior restoration project?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for an interior restoration project?

acceptedAnswer.text: The interior restoration process typically begins with an initial consultation and assessment to understand your goals and inspect the site. This leads to a detailed proposal and design plan, including material selections. Once approved, necessary permits are secured. Demolition and structural repairs follow, if needed, before proceeding with rough-ins for plumbing and electrical. Finishing stages include drywall, flooring, painting, and installing fixtures. The project concludes with a final walkthrough to ensure your complete satisfaction. Communication is maintained throughout each phase.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves consultation, proposal, permits, demolition, structural work, rough-ins, finishing, and a final walkthrough.
